projects.name: Ticker Talk
projects.description: Evidence-first research workspace for fundamental analysts. It answers SEC-filing questions with citations to the exact filing, period, and unit, and turns later filing changes into revisions the analyst approves or rejects. Running in production.
highlights: Point-in-time evaluation: expected answers are computed only from facts filed before each question's as-of date, then scored by a deterministic scorer and a pinned LLM judge
Deterministic code owns accounting, units, and calculations; the LLM plans, retrieves, and explains, and missing data surfaces as an explicit gap
Refocused the product from stock screening to filings after usage data showed 88 of 114 messages were filing questions and one was about screens
projects.technologies: Next.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, OpenRouter, Ollama, Clerk, Langfuse, Railway
